_note: Demo seed. Each passage paraphrases an official statement as reported by the linked source. Re-check every passage against the original before any public demo. Replace with direct INEC text where available.

passages.publisher: INEC, as reported by Africa Check
passages.text: INEC said the 2027 campaign timetable graphic circulating on social media in late July 2026 is fake and was not issued by the commission.

passages.document_title: Revised timetable for the 2027 general elections
passages.publisher: INEC, as reported by News Central
passages.text: INEC released the revised timetable for the 2027 general elections on 26 February 2026. The presidential and National Assembly elections are scheduled for 16 January 2027.

passages.document_title: Only voters with PVCs may vote
passages.publisher: INEC, as reported by Premium Times
passages.text: INEC says only duly registered voters in possession of valid Permanent Voter Cards will be allowed to vote on election day.

passages.document_title: PVC distribution resumes in registration areas
passages.text: INEC said distribution of Permanent Voter Cards would return to Registration Areas nationwide from 1 December 2026.
